examples.text: kodhanaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalaṃ kodh'ābhibhūtaṃ kodhaparetaṃ, ye'pi'ssa te honti mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, te'pi ārakā parivajjanti kodh'ābhibhūtaṃ.
tatra, bhikkhave, ye te makkaṭā abālajātikā alolajātikā, te taṃ lepaṃ disvā ārakā parivajjanti. yo pana so hoti makkaṭo bālajātiko lolajātiko, so taṃ lepaṃ upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti.

44205.commentary: (MNa) dassanā pahātabbā'ti dassanena pahātabbā. esa nayo sabbattha.

44208.meaning1: completely avoiding; shunning; keeping away from

examples.text: bhuñjati anavajjāni, sāvajjāni na bhuñjati, ghāsam'acchādanaṃ laddhā, sannidhiṃ parivajjayaṃ.
yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, aparivajjayato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, parivajjayato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā.
yo kāme parivajjeti, sappass'eva padā siro, so imaṃ visattikaṃ loke, sato samativattati.
pāpāni parivajjeti, sa munī tena so muni, yo munāti ubho loke, muni tena pavuccati.
yo'pi vassasataṃ jīve, so'pi maccuparāyaṇo, na kiñci parivajjeti, sabbam'ev'ābhimaddatī'ti.

44212.meaning2: having shunned, having avoided, having kept away from

so kho ahaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena… appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
tena kho pana samayena jānapadā manussā bahuṃ loṇam'pi telam'pi taṇḍulam'pi khādanīyam'pi sakaṭesu āropetvā bahārāmakoṭṭhake sakaṭaparivaṭṭaṃ karitvā acchanti

44219.meaning1: having caused to spin around; having made circle around

examples.text: yaṃ buddhaseṭṭho parivaṇṇayī suciṃ, samādhim'ānantarikañ'ñam'āhu, samādhinā tena samo na vijjati, idam'pi dhamme ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

44221.meaning1: changing; twisting around; moving about; spinning

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ lahuparivattaṃ yatha'y'idaṃ cittaṃ. yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, upamā'pi na sukarā yāva lahuparivattaṃ cittan'ti.
so n'ātidūre n'āccāsanne āsanassa parivattati, na ca pāṇinā ālambitvā āsane nisīdati, na ca āsanasmiṃ kāyaṃ pakkhipati.

vighāto c'āhaṃ paripatāmi chamāyaṃ, parivattāmi vāricaro'va ghamme, rudato ca me assukā niggalanti, ācikkha bhante kissa ayaṃ vipāko, pucchāmi taṃ etam'atthaṃ bhadante, kathaṃ nu ucchuparibhogaṃ labheyyan'ti.
negamajānapadesu adhammikesu visamaṃ candimasūriyā parivattanti. visamaṃ candimasūriyesu parivattantesu visamaṃ nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni parivattanti.

evaṃ pamatto rasagārave ratto, bālo yadī āyati n'āvabujjhati, vidhamma putte caji ñātake ca, parivattiya attānam'eva khādati.
kayavikkayaṃ samāpajjeyyā'ti iminā imaṃ dehi, iminā imaṃ āhara, iminā imaṃ parivattehi, iminā imaṃ cetāpehī'ti. ajjhācarati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
na vattabbā, detha me vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ, āharatha me vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ, parivattetha me vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ, cetāpetha me vassikasāṭikacīvaran'ti.

ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi, catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyā'ti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṭṭhañ'ca paṭicca valliñ'ca paṭicca tiṇañ'ca paṭicca mattikañ'ca paṭicca ākāso parivārito agāraṃ tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati, evam'eva kho, āvuso, aṭṭhiñ'ca paṭicca nhāruñ'ca paṭicca maṃsañ'ca paṭicca cammañ'ca paṭicca ākāso parivārito rūpaṃ tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mohasambandhano loko, bhabbarūpo'va dissati, upadhibandhano bālo, tamasā parivārito, sassato'riva khāyati, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.
saṅghamajjhe vā gaṇamajjhe vā salāk'agga-yāg'agga-vitakkamāḷaka-bhikkhācāramagga-āsanasāl'ādīsu vā upaṭṭhākehi parivāritakkhaṇe vā codento akālena vadati nāma. tacchena vadanto bhūtena vadati nāma.

44281.commentary: (DNa) samantā parivāretha, mā vo muñcittha koci nan'ti tumhākaṃ eko'pi etesu ekam'pi mā muñci. mā vo muñcethā'ti'pi pāṭho, es'ev'attho.

examples.text: etha gaṇhatha bandhatha, rāgena baddhamatthu vo, samantā parivāretha, mā vo muñcittha koci naṃ.

44282.meaningLit: having caused to cover all around

examples.text: atthi me, bho raṭṭhapāla, anusāyiko ābādho. app'ekadā maṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā parivāretvā ṭhitā honti, idāni rājā korabyo kālaṃ karissati, idāni rājā korabyo kālaṃ karissatī'ti.
etasmiṃ ṭhāne mahāsampatti hoti, bodhisattaṃ parivāretvā nisinnā dhātiyo rañño sampattiṃ passissāmā'ti antosāṇito bahi nikkhantā.

44283.meaningLit: having caused to cover all around

44285.notes: penance imposed for concealing saṅghādisesa offences

examples.text: saṅgh'ādiseso'ti saṅgho'va tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ deti, mūlāya paṭikassati, mānattaṃ deti, abbheti, na sambahulā, na ekapuggalo. tena vuccati, saṅgh'ādiseso'ti.
parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttariṃ chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ.

so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya, ahañ'hi garudhammaṃ ajjhāpanno parivās'āraho, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan'ti, gantabbaṃ, bhikkhave, satt'āhakaraṇīyena, appahite'pi, pag'eva pahite, parivāsadānaṃ ussukkaṃ karissāmi vā, anussāvessāmi vā, gaṇapūrako vā bhavissāmī'ti.

44289.meaning1: reflection; contemplation; train of thought; thought process

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato anuruddhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi

etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.

44290.meaning1: understanding the train of thought; comprehending the thought process

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā tassa bhikkhuno cetasā ceto parivitakkam'aññāya bhikkhū āmantesi
pubb'eva nu kho, etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato cetaso parivitakkitaṃ hoti ye maṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ pucchissanti tes'āhaṃ evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākarissāmī'ti, udāhu ṭhānaso'v'etaṃ tathāgataṃ paṭibhātī'ti?

44295.commentary: (VINa) upatiṭṭhitvā parivisatī'ti sabbakamm'ante vissajjetvā mahantaṃ pūjāsakkāraṃ katvā samīpe ṭhatvā parivisati.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena piṇḍapātena parivisati. tassa na evaṃ hoti, sādhu vata māyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena piṇḍapātena pariviseyyā'ti!

44296.commentary: (VISMa) parivisanto'ti bhojento. tassa ruccitvā bhuñjanākāraṃ sallakkhetvā tassa upanāmento'ti yojanā.

examples.text: saṅghaṃ kho pan'āhaṃ, bhante, parivisanto n'ābhijānāmi evaṃ cittaṃ uppādento, imassa vā thokaṃ demi imassa vā bahukan'ti. atha khv'āhaṃ, bhante, samacitto'va demi.
